    Bayesian Optimization via Mode-Seeking Surrogate (BOSS)

    BOSS_modal.Rd

    Run a GP-based sequential design algorithm that (every update_step iter): 1. Re-estimates GP length-scale/noise; 2. Optimizes an acquisition function (UCB) to pick the next x; 3. Optionally checks a modal‐based convergence criterion.

    BOSS_modal(
  func,
  update_step = 5,
  max_iter = 100,
  D = 1,
  quad = FALSE,
  lower = rep(0, D),
  upper = rep(1, D),
  nu = Inf,
  noise_var = 1e-06,
  modal_iter_check = 10,
  modal_check_warmup = 20,
  modal_k.nn = 5,
  modal_eps = 0.1,
  initial_design = 5,
  delta = 0.01,
  optim.n = 5,
  optim.max.iter = 1000,
  opt.lengthscale.grid = NULL,
  opt.grid = NULL,
  verbose = 3
)

    Arguments

    func

    A function f: [0,1]^D -> R to optimize.

    update_step

    Integer; how often to refit the GP hyperparameters.

    max_iter

    Maximum number of BO iterations.

    D

    Input dimension.

    quad

    Logical; if FALSE (default), use a zero-mean GP model. If TRUE, fit a linear-plus-quadratic mean model \(\beta_0 + x^\top \beta_1 + (x \otimes x)^\top \beta_2\) alongside the GP.

    lower

    Numeric vector of length D giving lower bounds (in original scale).

    upper

    Numeric vector of length D giving upper bounds.

    noise_var

    GP observation noise variance.

    modal_iter_check

    How often (in iterations) to check convergence via modal criteria.

    modal_check_warmup

    Minimum iter before starting modal checks.

    modal_k.nn

    Number of nearest neighbours to use in modal criterion.

    modal_eps

    Convergence threshold for the modal criterion.

    initial_design

    Number of initial points to sample.

    delta

    Exploration parameter passed to UCB.

    optim.n

    Number of multistart in acquisition optimization.

    optim.max.iter

    Maxit for length-scale optimization.

    opt.lengthscale.grid

    Optional grid size for length-scale search.

    opt.grid

    Optional grid size for acquisition search.

    verbose

    Verbosity level (0–3).

    Value

    A "boss" object (S3 class boss), which is a list containing:

    objective_function

    The original objective function f.

    D

    Input dimension of the objective function.

    design_points

    List with components x (scaled inputs), x_original (original inputs), and y (responses).

    gp_params

    List with length_scale and signal_var, the final GP hyperparameters.

    surrogate

    A function (xvalue) -> numeric giving the GP posterior mean at xvalue.

    essential_support

    Placeholder for essential support (to be computed later).

    fill_in

    Placeholder for additional outputs (to be computed later).

    modal_result

    Data frame of modal-difference diagnostics collected during optimization.
